title: Minestrone
description: A hearty Italian vegetable soup with beans, small pasta, tomatoes and greens, finished with Parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil.

image.alt: A bowl of minestrone with beans, pasta and vegetables

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in the pot over medium heat. Add the onion, carrots and celery and cook, stirring now and then, until softened, {time 8-10 min}. Add the garlic and cook for {time 1 min}.
Stir in the zucchini, tomatoes, broth, oregano and salt. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat and simmer, partly covered, for {time 15 min}.
Add the beans and pasta and simmer, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender, {time 10-12 min}.
Stir in the kale and cook until wilted, {time 2-3 min}. Taste for salt. If the soup is very thick, add a splash of water.
Ladle into bowls and top with the cheese and a drizzle of the remaining olive oil.

notes: The pasta keeps absorbing broth. If you plan to have leftovers, cook the pasta separately and add it to each bowl.
Keeps in the fridge for 4 days. Freeze without the pasta for up to 3 months.
